facts.about: Larsen & Toubro Ltd is a multinational conglomerate which is primarily engaged in providing engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) solutions in key sectors such as Infrastructure, Hydrocarbon, Power, Process Industries and Defence, Information Technology and Financial Services in domestic and international markets.

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 115% of PAT

business.summary: Larsen & Toubro Ltd. is an Indian company primarily engaged in EPC projects for infrastructure and energy, alongside hi-tech manufacturing of equipment and systems. It generates revenue through these core businesses, IT and technology services, and financial services.

segments.name: Infrastructure Projects
segments.note: Revenue remained stable during the year.

segments.name: Energy Projects
segments.note: Growth driven by strong execution and improved order conversion.

segments.name: IT & Technology Services
segments.note: Growth driven by scaling of technology-led businesses.

segments.name: Financial Services
segments.note: Recorded steady growth during the year.

segments.name: Hi-Tech Manufacturing
segments.note: Growth driven by improved order conversion.

segments.name: Development Projects

guidance.statement: We remain confident of achieving our order inflow growth guidance of 10% to 12% band.
guidance.quote: Given the strength of our opportunity pipeline and the underlying market dynamics, we remain confident of achieving our order inflow growth guidance of 10% to 12% band for the current year.

guidance.statement: We remain committed to our FY '27 growth guidance of 10% to 12% revenue growth.
guidance.quote: For now, we remain committed to our FY '27 growth guidance of 10% to 12% revenue growth guidance.

guidance.statement: We continue to target the margin of around 7.8% for FY '27 for the PPM portfolio.
guidance.quote: In line with our Revenue growth guidance, we continue to target the margin of around 7.8% for FY '27 with respect to the PPM portfolio.

guidance.statement: We are maintaining our FY '27 working capital guidance of around 10%.
guidance.quote: Factoring in the expected utilization of customer advances and increased vendor payments as the execution accelerates in H2, we are maintaining our FY '27 working capital guidance of around 10%.

guidance.statement: We expect the group order inflows to grow in the range of 10% to 12% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Based on this visibility and the opportunities we are pursuing, we expect the group order inflows to grow in the range of 10% to 12% in FY27.

guidance.statement: We expect growth to be in the range of 10% to 12% for FY27.
guidance.quote: On Revenue, we expect growth to be in the range of 10% to 12% for FY27.

guidance.statement: We expect the PP&M margin to be stable at 7.8% in FY27.
guidance.quote: On this reclassified basis, the FY26 margins for Projects, Products and Manufacturing was 7.8%, and we expect the same to be stable as well in FY27 as well.

guidance.statement: We are guiding the working capital to be around 10% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we are guiding the working capital to be around 10% in FY27, which remains well within our targeted range.

guidance.statement: We are targeting order inflow growth at a CAGR of 10% to 12% over the next five years.
guidance.quote: Concluding with the Lakshya guidance, over the next five years, we are targeting order inflow growth at a CAGR return of 10% to 12%, revenue growth of 12% to 15%, and a Return on Equity in the range of 16% to 17%.

guidance.statement: We are targeting revenue growth at a CAGR of 12% to 15% over the next five years.
guidance.quote: Concluding with the Lakshya guidance, over the next five years, we are targeting order inflow growth at a CAGR return of 10% to 12%, revenue growth of 12% to 15%, and a Return on Equity in the range of 16% to 17%.

guidance.statement: We are targeting a Return on Equity in the range of 16% to 17% over the next five years.
guidance.quote: Concluding with the Lakshya guidance, over the next five years, we are targeting order inflow growth at a CAGR return of 10% to 12%, revenue growth of 12% to 15%, and a Return on Equity in the range of 16% to 17%.

guidance.statement: We will be exceeding the 10% order inflow guidance for FY '26.
guidance.quote: Basis the 9-month performance and the healthy prospects pipeline for the near term, we will be exceeding the 10% order inflow guidance for FY '26.

guidance.statement: We are reasonably confident of achieving our full year revenue growth guidance of 15%.
guidance.quote: We expect the customary ramp-up in project execution during Q4 and are reasonably confident of achieving our full year revenue growth guidance of 15%.

guidance.statement: Our Projects & Manufacturing EBITDA at 7.9% for 9 months is in line with the 8.5% target.
guidance.quote: Our Projects & Manufacturing EBITDA at 7.9% for 9 months of the current year is in line with the target that we have set ourselves at 8.5% for the full year FY '26.

guidance.statement: We expect to close the year with a revised target of around 10%.
guidance.quote: However, with stronger collection intensity and improved contractual terms, our Net Working Capital to Revenue has improved sharply to 8.2% as of December '25, and we expect to close the year with a revised target of around 10%.

guidance.statement: We are confident of exceeding our full year FY '26 guidance of 10% growth in group order inflows.
guidance.quote: We are confident of exceeding our full year FY '26 guidance of 10% growth in group order inflows for the current year.

guidance.statement: We maintain our full year revenue growth guidance at 15%.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we maintain our full year revenue growth guidance at 15%.

guidance.statement: We are reasonably confident to achieve our full year EBITDA margin target of 8.5%.
guidance.quote: With the execution momentum expected to pick up in H2, we are reasonably confident to achieve our full year EBITDA margin target of 8.5%.

guidance.statement: Our guidance for working capital for FY '26 remains unchanged at around 12% by March 2026.
guidance.quote: Our guidance for working capital for FY '26 remains unchanged at around 12% by March 2026.

scorecard.promised: Maintain full year revenue growth guidance at 15%.
scorecard.evidence: FY26 revenue of ₹285,874 cr vs FY25 of ₹255,734 cr represents 11.8% growth, missing the 15% target.

scorecard.promised: Targeting revenue growth in the range of 10% to 12% for FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Current run-rate shows 11.6% growth for H1 FY27.
scorecard.evidence: H1 FY27 revenue of ₹146,692 cr vs H1 FY26 of ₹131,426 cr is 11.6% growth, within the guided range.

scorecard.promised: Targeting a stable margin of around 7.8% for the PPM portfolio.
scorecard.delivered: Consolidated operating margins fell to 11% in Q2 FY27.
scorecard.evidence: Operating margins dropped from 13% in FY26 to 11% in Sep 2026, suggesting pressure on the 7.8% PPM target.

scorecard.promised: Guiding the working capital to be around 10% in FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Working capital was revised from 12% down to 10% during FY26.
scorecard.evidence: Management lowered the target from 12% in Q2 FY26 to 10% by Q3 FY26 and maintained it for FY27.

scorecard.promised: Confident of achieving order inflow growth guidance of 10% to 12%.
scorecard.delivered: Exceeded 10% guidance in FY26; FY27 performance is currently tracking.
scorecard.evidence: Management confirmed exceeding the 10% FY26 target; FY27 guidance remains at 10-12%.

narrative.scoreline: Management has demonstrated strong order book momentum but struggled to convert this into the promised 15% revenue growth for FY26.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Revenue growth was impacted by supply chain constraints and domestic execution delays.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Revenue growth slowed from 20.6% in Sep 2024 to 6.7% in Jun 2026.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Margin pressure is due to legacy projects expected to conclude in a few quarters.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Operating margins have declined from 13% in early FY26 to 11% by Sep 2026.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Working capital improved sharply due to stronger collection intensity.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Cash conversion cycle has deteriorated to -151 days from -172 days three years ago.

bull: Order inflow growth consistently meets or exceeds the 10-12% target range across multiple quarters.
Strong cash generation with 5-year operating cash flow representing 115% of reported PAT.
Revenue growth for H1 FY27 of 11.6% is currently tracking within the guided 10-12% range.
bear: Missed FY26 revenue growth guidance of 15%, delivering only 11.8% for the full year.
Operating margins have compressed to 11% in the most recent quarter, down from 13% averages.
High leverage with debt at 1.24x equity and total borrowings reaching ₹1.40L crore.
watch: Consummation of Hyderabad Metro divestment by March 2026 to reduce capital intensity.
Stabilization of PPM margins at the 7.8% target as legacy projects exit.
Recovery of revenue growth in the Water segment following payment normalization.

claims.claim: We are managing logistics issues via alternative routes and consulting customers to ensure project sites are not impacted.
claims.quote: We have logistics issues, but we are managing that, as PR said, and making sure that the project sites are not impacted because of the disruption, by managing alternative routes.

claims.claim: We have no plans to diversify EPC geography beyond India, Middle East, and select CIS countries, except offshore wind.
claims.quote: We have no plans to diversify in terms of geography for EPC business except for the offshore wind farm business.

claims.claim: The Q1 bump in ECL provisions is a one-time effect and will not repeat in the balance three quarters.
claims.quote: But I do not think is going to happen in the balance three quarters of the year.

claims.claim: All project sites are functioning, no projects have been cancelled, and client payments continue as per schedule.
claims.quote: On the Middle East situation, we would like to clarify that all our project sites are functioning as of date. All our employees and workforce are safe, and none of our projects have been cancelled.

claims.claim: Revenue growth was impacted by supply chain constraints and execution delays in water and other domestic projects.
claims.quote: The variance was primarily attributable to subdued execution progress in certain domestic projects, more particularly within the Water and Effluent Treatment business as well as delays arising from pending clearances on a few projects.

claims.claim: Supply chain is the biggest risk, but it is improving as alternate routes open up.
claims.quote: The biggest risk is the supply chain, but it is continuously getting better. I mean, there are much better movements now between the GCC countries and some alternate routes have opened up.

claims.claim: Margin pressure is due to legacy projects which will conclude in the next 2-3 quarters.
claims.quote: As highlighted in previous earnings calls, these projects are in their terminate execution phase and are expected to conclude over the next few quarters, during which margins will remain soft.

claims.claim: Canceled projects are strategically important and will return to the market this calendar year.
claims.quote: But these projects cannot be canceled because these are strategically important projects. These are very important for maintaining their production as well as for meeting their targets. So they will come back.

claims.claim: Execution is calibrated to fund availability, which is expected to normalize within a quarter.
claims.quote: It is a bit unfortunate that there has been some kind of suspension of the work in those areas because of the payment issues. But we are continuously in dialogue with the government.

claims.claim: We expect the transaction to divest our stake to the Government of Telangana to be consummated by March 2026.
claims.quote: The contours of the final agreement are being finalized, and we expect this transaction to get consummated by the end of the current fiscal FY '26.

claims.claim: Soft margins in the energy segment will persist in the near term due to legacy project cost overruns.
claims.quote: We do anticipate soft margins in the segment to persist in the near term. As already communicated during our Q1 FY '26 Earnings Call, this is factored into our FY '26 P&L margin guidance.

claims.claim: We are expanding our thermal power equipment manufacturing capacity to handle 10-15 GW of additional orders.
claims.quote: We are going ahead with expansion of our capacity, and we are gearing up for taking up additional maybe 10, 15 gigawatts in the next 2, 3 years.

risks.text: Significant contingent liabilities exist regarding claims, tax, and performance guarantees for subsidiaries and joint ventures.
Revenue recognition for construction contracts involves significant management judgments and estimates regarding total costs.
Consolidated financial statements include 35 joint operations accounted for on a proportionate basis.
